_comment: SAMPLE PRICES — placeholders so the demo runs. This is YOUR default price list: edit freely, or point GHL_PROPOSAL_RATE_CARD at your own file. A proposal can also override a price or add a custom line, but only with a number you gave.

a2p-setup.name: A2P registration & phone number setup
a2p-setup.description: Business registration and texting number setup so messages are actually delivered.

lead-funnel.name: Lead capture funnel
lead-funnel.description: Landing page and form that drops every new lead straight into your pipeline.

missed-call-textback.name: Missed-call text-back
missed-call-textback.description: Instant text to any caller you didn't pick up, so the job doesn't go to the next contractor.

speed-to-lead.name: New-lead follow-up sequence
speed-to-lead.description: Automatic call, text and email follow-up in the first minutes and days after an inquiry.

review-requests.name: Review request automation
review-requests.description: A review request goes out automatically when a job is marked complete.

pipeline-reporting.name: Pipeline & reporting dashboard
pipeline-reporting.description: One view of leads, estimates, booked jobs and revenue by source.

monthly-management.name: Monthly management & support (first month)
monthly-management.description: Ongoing monitoring, fixes and adjustments. Continues monthly at this rate until cancelled.

terms: 50% due on acceptance, balance on delivery.

terms.text: Monthly management renews monthly and can be cancelled with 30 days' notice.

terms: Third-party fees (phone numbers, texting, email sending) are billed at cost.
